usageNotes: Orders a new ACME (Let's Encrypt) certificate for the specified PDM node; the node must have an ACME account and at least one domain configured before calling this endpoint. Returns a UPID — poll the task log to confirm issuance success before assuming the certificate is live. Use the `force` flag only when you need to replace an unexpired certificate, as it will overwrite the existing cert and key immediately.

examples.summary: Order a new ACME certificate for a PDM node (standard, non-forced)

tips: ACME account and domain(s) must be configured on the node via the PDM web UI or API before ordering.
The returned UPID is asynchronous — use a task-status endpoint to wait for completion before testing the certificate.
Let's Encrypt rate-limits failed issuance attempts per domain; avoid repeated forced renewals in a short window.
If the node hostname does not resolve publicly, HTTP-01 challenge will fail; ensure DNS or an appropriate challenge plugin is set up.
